tailoring.headline: Product Owner & SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Expert | 5+ Years E-Commerce Development
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs, headless commerce, and PIM/ERP/MDM integrations. Proven record in designing data pipelines, API migrations, and production support. Strong techno-functional consulting skills: requirements analysis, user story creation, stakeholder coordination, and AI-assisted development. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer, fluent in English, work-authorized in Germany.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Product Owner - SAP Commerce Cloud (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: I am excited about your commitment to modernize B2B e-commerce with SAP Commerce Cloud. With 5+ years delivering large-scale Hybris solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I can immediately drive value as your Product Owner.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Leadership
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I acted as the bridge between business owners and IT, analysing requirements, writing user stories and functional specs, and delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions that met global e-commerce needs.

bullets.label: API & Integration Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and implemented OCC REST services and end-to-end PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines (Profisee, DataHub, Hotfolders), ensuring seamless product catalog synchronization across ERP and MDM systems.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & Stakeholder Management
bullets.text: Led agile Scrum teams, performed code reviews, and coordinated with international technical teams to resolve integration bottlenecks, delivering releases on schedule.

bullets.label: Performance & Production Support
bullets.text: Optimised SQL queries and FlexibleSearch, reducing response latency, and provided 24/7 production support, quickly resolving incidents for high-traffic B2B portals.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, I hold a valid residence and work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Product Owner - SAP Commerce Cloud (m/w/d)
cover_de.hook: Die Weiterentwicklung Ihrer B2B-Commerce-Plattform mit SAP Commerce Cloud begeistert mich. Mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von Hybris-Lösungen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell kann ich als Product Owner sofort Mehrwert schaffen.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Leadership
bullets.text: Bei Rockwell Automation fungierte ich als Schnittstelle zwischen Fachbereichen und IT, analysierte Anforderungen, erstellte User Stories und funktionale Spezifikationen und lieferte SAP Commerce Cloud-Lösungen, die den globalen E-Commerce-Bedürfnissen entsprachen.

bullets.label: API- und Integrations-Expertise
bullets.text: Ich entwickelte OCC-REST-Services und end-to-end PIM-zu-Hybris-Datenpipelines (Profisee, DataHub, Hotfolders) und stellte damit eine nahtlose Synchronisation von Produktkatalogen über ERP- und MDM-Systeme sicher.

bullets.label: Agile Lieferung & Stakeholder-Management
bullets.text: Ich leitete agile Scrum-Teams, führte Code-Reviews durch und koordinierte mit internationalen Technik-Teams, um Integrationsengpässe zu beheben und Releases termingerecht zu liefern.

bullets.label: Performance- und Produktions-Support
bullets.text: Durch Optimierung von SQL-Abfragen und FlexibleSearch reduzierte ich die Antwortzeiten und bot 24/7-Produktionssupport, um Vorfälle in stark frequentierten B2B-Portalen schnell zu beheben.

cover_de.logistics: Ich wohne in Karlsruhe, besitze eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis, befinde mich in der Kündigungsfrist bis zum 15.12.2026 und kann ab dem 16.12.2026 starten. Ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch, um meine Ideen einzubringen.

tailoring.why_company: I am impressed by your strategic focus on delivering a seamless, headless commerce experience for enterprise B2B customers and your recent investment in expanding SAP Commerce Cloud capabilities. Your commitment to agile product development aligns perfectly with my background in leading cross-functional teams and delivering high-performance Hybris solutions, making this role a natural fit for my expertise.
tailoring.motivation_short: Your vision to accelerate headless SAP Commerce Cloud adoption matches my proven track record in building scalable Hybris platforms and driving agile product ownership.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m eager to discuss how my API, integration and product-owner experience can help your team deliver next-gen e-commerce solutions.
tailoring.offer: In the first months I will modernize your OCC/Spartacus integration layer and streamline PIM-ERP data pipelines, leveraging my proven experience at Rockwell Automation. I will also provide immediate production support, reducing incident resolution times through optimized query performance and proactive monitoring.
tailoring.insight: Your posting highlights a need to expand headless commerce capabilities; I can accelerate this by applying my OCC API development and DataHub integration expertise to deliver fast, scalable storefronts.
tailoring.email_subject: Application – Product Owner SAP Commerce Cloud (m/w/d)
tailoring.email_body: Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren, ich bin Kranti Chavan, Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Entwickler aus Karlsruhe. Ihre ambitionierte Roadmap für headless Commerce begeistert mich, und ich bringe über fünf Jahre Erfahrung in Hybris-Entwicklung, API-Integration und agiler Produktverantwortung mit. Ich kann sofort Ihre OCC- und PIM-ERP-Schnittstellen optimieren und die Produktionsstabilität erhöhen. Einblick: Ihre geplante Erweiterung des Headless-Stacks passt zu meinem Know-how. Lebenslauf und Anschreiben liegen bei.
